openedTimingConclusion.basis: The two direct instructions use x19+656 as their architectural store address. A hardware stop at the watched roleBase+656 therefore proves that top-frame x19 equals the watched role base at those stops.
openedTimingConclusion.conclusion: For the direct +0xb5c and +0x3970 writes, x19 necessarily matches the watched role, yet the exact-frame matcher rejected the event. Therefore x28 is not the independently selected source at those early writes. At the later +0x3ef0 marker in the live frame, x28 is the selected source. Simultaneous x19/x28 matching at the write is an invalid temporal identity rule.
